error_offline: The hub could not be reached. Check the address and the connection.
error_not_built: The hub does not do this yet.
connect_scan_body: On the web or the desktop app, open Settings → Device connections and choose to pair a device. Then scan the code it shows.
connect_scan_prompt: Point the camera at the pairing code
connect_pairing_invalid: That is not a Core Hub pairing code, or it has expired. Make a new one and scan again.
connect_or_address: Or sign in with the hub's address
connect_hub_invalid: Type the hub's address, like hub.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8787
setup_open_body: This hub has no owner yet. Whoever sets it up now becomes its owner.
setup_token_body: This hub has no owner yet. Enter the setup token from the hub's log or from setup-token.txt in its data folder.
pair_switch_body: This phone is signed in. Pairing with %1$s signs it out here first.
chat_no_agents_body: No agent is installed in this profile. An owner or admin installs one from Agents.
approval_memory: %1$s wants to write to its memory
approval_plan: %1$s asks you to approve a plan
approval_step: A workflow step waits for you
admin_only: Only an owner or an admin can open this page.
on_the_web_body: This page is on the web for now. It opens there, on the same hub.
about_license: %1$s is free software under the Apache License 2.0.
agent_settings_read_only: Read-only on the phone. Change them on the web.
voice_input_hint: The microphone in the composer, with this phone's own speech recognizer.
voice_unavailable: This phone has no speech recognizer.
voice_spoken_hint: Read a finished reply aloud while its chat is on screen.
notices_push_active: Push is on: the hub sends each notice straight to this phone, even while the app is closed.
notices_push_checking: Setting up push with the hub…
notices_push_not_in_build: This build of the app has no push. It shows a notice when the hub announces it while the app runs, and looks for new ones every 15 minutes while it is closed.
notices_push_no_sender: The hub has no Android push sender yet (Device connections → Push senders). Until it does, the app looks for new notices every 15 minutes while it is closed.
notices_push_failed: Push could not be set up just now. The app looks for new notices every 15 minutes while it is closed, and tries push again at the next launch.
notices_background: Check while the app is closed
notices_background_hint: Every 15 minutes, when there is a network.
update_bad_file: The downloaded file did not match the release. Nothing was installed.
update_allow_hint: Allow %1$s to install apps in the setting that opens, then tap Install.
update_failed: The download stopped. Check the connection and try again.
update_unreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.
update_rate_limited: GitHub is busy right now. Try again in an hour.
update_store: Google Play keeps this copy up to date.
update_auto_hint: The app also looks for a new version by itself when you open it, at most every 6 hours.
logs_kept: The latest lines of the hub and of every Hermes gateway, kept in the hub’s memory — a restart empties them. Pull the newest with Refresh.
perf_no_proc: This host has no /proc, so the Hermes processes are listed without their numbers.
perf_no_hermes: The hub runs no Hermes process right now.
attach_too_large: This file is over %1$s, the largest the hub takes.
attach_unreadable: This file could not be read.
attach_camera_denied: Core Hub may not use the camera. Allow it in the phone settings.
voice_source_hint: Core Hub uses the profile's speech providers on the hub for dictation and reading replies aloud; when the hub has none, this phone's own voice is used.
voice_no_speech: Nothing was heard. Try again a little closer to the microphone.
voice_mic_denied: Core Hub may not use the microphone. Allow it in the phone settings.
push_no_sender: The hub has no Android sender yet
notices_off: Notifications are off for Core Hub
voice_language_auto_hint: Listens in the language of the keyboard you are typing with; without one, in the language of the conversation, then your phone's.
attach_open_failed: This file could not be opened.
files_offline: The hub could not be reached. Try again.
files_gone: This file is no longer on the hub.
files_too_large: This file is too large to open here.
files_link_failed: No app on this phone opens this link.
room_archived: This room is archived: it can be read, not written in.
room_placeholder: Message the room · @ names an agent
room_invite_hint: Anyone who may enter this profile can join with the code or its link.
room_lead_hint: The first agent is the lead: it answers a message that names nobody.
room_already_member: You are already in this room.
chats_batch_delete_body: They are deleted for good, with their messages.
chat_export_failed: The chat could not be exported. Try again.
chat_start_hint: Ask anything. The conversation starts with your first message.
